answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the lantern log reveals the live set and the haven audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 898 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 193 aliases alive thus means 193 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the wharf quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 37 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
